'''Maltok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[permitor]] associated to [[House Renseth]]. A boisterous, egotistic and vain person, Maltok lived and worked in [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]]. He despised any outsider who used the services of other permitors.

In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Maltok approached a landing ship, hoping that the visitors would hire her as their permitor. Other prospectives included [[Furran]], [[Gusimin]] the Honest, [[Koyi Kobad]] and [[Sadana]]. All of them were disappointed to discover that they had already hired [[Fot Ducela]].

==Behind the scenes==
Maltok said he was "Grand Permitor of House Renseth", although the exact meaning of this utterance is unclear: Maltok could simply be bragging, House Renseth might have several people with that rank, or maybe Maltok did have special privileges.
